DiscussionIdDto.description: A GitLab discussion ID of a selected-thread batch.

FindingIdDto.description: A report finding ID: `F-` and the finding's number, written with at least two digits and no other leading zero, such as `F-01` or `F-100`.

GitShaDto.description: A full SHA-1 or SHA-256 Git object name.

assess_finding.description: Records what became of a finding already on file.

checkedSha.description: The commit you checked, when it differs from the reviewed revision of the closing call.

discussionIds.description: The GitLab discussions this outcome answers.

expectedRevision.description: The revision you last read of this finding.

outcome.description: `fixed`, `clarified_withdrawn` and `superseded` retire the finding. The others keep it active.

reason.description: One line saying what you checked.

assess_finding.title: AssessFinding

Assessment.description: The lead's conclusion on one selected discussion of a follow-up batch.

DiscussionIdDto.description: A GitLab discussion ID of a selected-thread batch.

FindingIdDto.description: A report finding ID: `F-` and the finding's number, written with at least two digits and no other leading zero, such as `F-01` or `F-100`.

ReportRevision.description: The reviewed revision: `{sha}` with the exact full SHA, or `{sha: null, reason}` when it is unknown.

reason.description: Why the reviewed commit is unknown. Only with a null sha.

sha.description: The full SHA of the reviewed commit, or null when it is unknown.

finish_review.description: Closes the review and publishes a version. A first or full review needs `verdict` and `revision`; a selected-thread check needs one entry in `assessments` per selected discussion.

assessments.description: One per selected discussion of a selected-thread check, and only there.

fullReview.description: Publish a full review of the whole MR. Every active finding of the last version must then be changed or assessed.

revision.description: The reviewed commit. Required for a first version and a full review. ReviewQ binds a selected-thread check's commit itself.

verdict.description: Required for a first version and a full review. Otherwise it defaults to the current version's verdict.

finish_review.title: FinishReview

needs_input.description: Records a question the reviewer must answer before the review can finish, and holds the review until then. It publishes nothing.

reason.description: The question, and what the review waits on. Ask it in your reply as well: the reviewer is told only that the review needs input.

needs_input.title: NeedsInput

FindingBasis.description: What the agent confirmed (`observed`) or could not verify (`gap`).

FindingIdDto.description: A report finding ID: `F-` and the finding's number, written with at least two digits and no other leading zero, such as `F-01` or `F-100`.

FindingLocation.description: A file a finding points at, with an optional 1-based line.

Severity.description: A finding's severity, most severe first.

record_finding.description: Files a new finding, or changes the finding named by `id`. A new finding gives `title`, `severity`, `blocking`, `section`, `issue`, `consequence` and `evidence`. A change gives `id`, `expectedRevision` and only the fields it changes.

blocking.description: Whether the lead holds the merge on this finding.

category.description: A one-line label without `·`, such as Security or Tests. Defaults to the section's name.

consequence.description: Markdown starting with a paragraph: why it matters.

details.description: Markdown for diagrams, tables and longer reasoning, shown after the evidence. An empty string removes it.

expectedRevision.description: The revision you last read of the finding named by `id`. Required with `id`.

id.description: The finding to change. Leave it out to file a new finding.

issue.description: Markdown starting with a paragraph: what is wrong.

locations.description: The files the finding points at. An empty list removes them.

proposedComment.description: Markdown starting with a paragraph: the comment the lead would post. An empty string removes it.

section.description: `functional` or `quality`. Security and correctness concerns are functional.

title.description: One line naming the problem, without a severity label such as `P1 –`.

record_finding.title: RecordFinding

NoteSection.description: The section a review note fills.

body.description: The note's Markdown. An empty body removes the note.

expectedRevision.description: The revision you last read of this note. Required once the note exists.

section.description: `title` is the report's title, on one line. `summary` says what the MR does in at most four plain paragraphs and `rationale` gives the reason for the verdict in one.

title.description: One line naming an `extra` note. Required for `extra` and only for it.

FindingIdDto.description: A report finding ID: `F-` and the finding's number, written with at least two digits and no other leading zero, such as `F-01` or `F-100`.

NoteSection.description: The section a review note fills.

PageCursorDto.description: An opaque keyset continuation for list resources.

review_ledger.description: Reads the ledger. With no field it returns the short list. Give `ids` or `sections`, not both.

cursor.description: The cursor a previous result returned. Send it with the same `ids` or `sections`.

ids.description: Findings to read in full. Leave out `sections` when you give these.

sections.description: Note sections to read in full. `extra` reads every extra note. Leave out `ids` when you give these.

review_ledger.title: ReviewLedger
